cues.text: A seventy-two year old man has a cough and weight loss.
He was recently treated for prostate cancer.
His chest radiograph shows a cannonball lesion.
Cannonball metastases are large, well circumscribed, round pulmonary metastases.
So this is a secondary lung tumour: a cancer that developed elsewhere and spread to the lungs through the bloodstream or lymphatics.
They are also called envolée de ballons, meaning balloons release.
